# Rhodes Rent a Boat
> Independent local boat rental and tour operator in Rhodes, Greece, since 1998.

## About
Rhodes Rent a Boat is a family-run boat tour operator based at Ionos Dragoumi 39, Rhodes Town, Greece 85100. We hand-pick the best boat experiences for visitors — from license-free self-drive rentals to guided tours, day cruises, sailing trips and weekly yacht charters across the Dodecanese islands. Operating season: May–October. Languages: English, German, Italian, French, Russian, Hebrew, Dutch, Polish.

## Key Pages
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/rodos-rent-boat: No-licence required self-drive boat rental, pricing from €65/hour, inclusions
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/rodos-rent-boat/licenses-free: License-free boat details, Greek maritime law, fleet specs
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/rodos-boat-tours: Guided daily boat tours to Symi, Lindos, Anthony Quinn Bay, Kallithea
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/rodos-boat-cruises: All-inclusive day and sunset cruises with meals and drinks
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/private-boat-tours: Private skippered boat charters, custom routes
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/rodos-charter: Weekly bareboat and crewed yacht charters, Dodecanese island-hopping
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/about-us: Company history, philosophy, credentials
- https://rhodesrentaboat.com/contact: Contact information, booking, location map

## Pricing (2026 season, subject to change)
- Self-drive boat hire: from €65/hour (Nireus 4.90m, 15HP) to €90/hour (Karel Paxos 170, 30HP)
- Guided boat tours: from €75/person (shared) to €350+ (private)
- Day cruises: from €75/person (all-inclusive)
- Yacht charter: from €1,175/week (bareboat)
